qc/runs/kittle-2026-10-09-r2/raw-evidence-index.json; qc/repairs/kittle-2026-10-08/tests/functional.cjs (sha256 6385813318c4... verified; app.js 8fc558c9... and server.js 03b52651... match the frozen solution)
evidence: Instances reviewed (all plural/every/exactly-one/unchanged wording in 16 functional, 5 polish, 4 visual, 2 gate criteria). Covered across the whole collection: wall_every_route checks list, search (3 terms), thread/transcript/search replays and direct transcript URL; wall_mentions_and_links covers mentions and pasted links; brief's 'everywhere a message appears' (thread, reply quote, search snippet, earlier versions, transcript) is covered by safe_formatting legs 1-3 plus edits_and_stale_edit leg 1 (literal earlier version). Retention: seed M-11 (7-day) has exactly two overdue non-held messages, K-1 and K-10, both checked (deleted_and_expired A/B); M-13 shortening 30->7 makes K-13 the only non-held overdue message (K-7 held), so 'deletes whatever is now too old' and 'off never brings anything back' are checked over the full overdue set. hold_scope checks parent and reply (H0, H1C) for 'exactly that message'. sent_once checks 'exactly once' in thread, search and transcript and order A,B,C in 2 users' threads, search and transcript; unread checks both of Dev's contexts. nested_replies requires quotes on each of R1-R3; search_and_transcript B requires author and time on each message; polish transcript_print/visual transcript_page say 'each/every message'. Unchanged guards (prompt.md line 41 'a re-read matches the previous state'; timer leg 5, edit leg 3, hold leg 4, wall_added_live leg 3, persistence Dev's M-13 count) involve no legitimate side effect between baseline and re-read: Dev's count is noted after all persistence writes, which touch only M-11/M-12, and the fixed clock prevents timer drift. DEFECT: functional judge.toml line 262 (persistence leg 3): '"Survey booked for Friday." appears exactly once in M-11, so nothing was imported again.' The collection is not pinned to search; read as the M-11 thread, the text legitimately appears twice because seeded reply K-4 (parent K-3) must show 'a short quote of what it is answering' (conversations.md). The golden does this: server.js:287 quote text = parent.body.slice(0,120), app.js:307 renders it in full in the thread. The golden harness verifies this leg only through the API body count (functional.cjs:511), not the browser-visible thread, so no measured evidence shows a browser judge reads the leg as intended. No configured judge run exists (raw-evidence-index scope).
counterexample: Conforming app (including the golden reference): after restart, the judge opens M-11 as Harriet and counts occurrences of 'Survey booked for Friday.' with find-in-page or thread innerText. It finds 2: K-3's body and K-4's required reply quote. Under prompt.md line 26 ('every sentence that names a step must hold'), persistence (weight 2.0) fails although nothing was re-imported. Conversely, a re-importing app that dedupes by body text or a judge that counts only search would pass; so the exactly-one ask is decided by which collection the judge picks rather than by the stated requirement.
suggested_fix: Pin the collection and exclude the legitimate quote, e.g. in persistence leg 3: 'and a search for "Survey booked for Friday." returns exactly one result, in M-11 (the quote above its reply "Thanks, Friday works." is not a second copy), so nothing was imported again.' Optionally also check the M-11 transcript lists it once. Then extend the golden harness leg to the browser-visible search result count and rerun.
